verdict.rationale: Agora documents its own recording capability for audio streams, video streams and web pages, plus a self-hosted recording option, so server-side recording is supported in some form. The evidence never says how recorded files are delivered, or that they can go to a developer's own storage bucket. missing for 10: documented delivery of recording files to customer-owned storage buckets (e.g. S3/GCS configuration), explicit server-side/cloud recording API docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can record a session server-side and receive the files in my own storage bucket

citations.quote: Flexible options to record audio streams, video streams, and web pages for archive, review, or distribution.
Self-hosted recording for control and compliance needs.
